rationale: Ranking directory useful once for mapping ME banking/finance advisers; URL check failed so re-verify before mining.
Second directory for one-off actor mapping plus country comparative guides; liveness unverified, re-check then mine.
Podgorica firm claiming central-bank liaison work, but no confirmed publication cadence yet.
Domestic business-law firm publishing in Montenegrin; banking/payments output not yet confirmed.
Official advocate roster: exhaustive local actor list to mine once, not a signal stream.
Consolidated texts of Zakon o platnom prometu with amendment history are valuable, but behind a paid subscription.
English outlet translating ME payment-law change (instant payments, Payment System Law) into operational deadlines — core A3 material.
SEO lead-generation advisory content, low credibility and not a reliable regulatory signal producer.
Directory profile on iflr1000.com, not the firm's own site; resolve Prelevic's primary domain before adding as a source.
Directory profile page rather than JPM's own newsroom; needs domain resolution to be monitorable.
Leading independent daily's economy desk; first reporter of CBCG supervisory measures and draft banking-law disputes.
Main ME investigative newsroom on financial crime and supervisory failure; early weak signals on banking/AML.
FOI-driven watchdog publishing regulator documents and comments on draft financial laws.
National agency business wire — earliest, least-mutated text of CBCG and ministry statements.
Public broadcaster economy feed carrying official CBCG/ministry and parliamentary-committee items; good corroboration baseline.
National daily linking supervisory action to prosecutions arising from bank failures and AML cases.
Adversarial daily useful as a weak-signal channel on the central bank; low credibility, always corroborate.
Independent weekly with longer-form analysis of central-bank and regulatory-capture issues; low cadence.
Established portal with an economy desk carrying CBCG/ministry announcements; mid-tier corroboration.
Economy rubric with browsable archive, useful for backfilling historical supervisory/consultation coverage.
Local broadcaster mostly republishing national copy; redundant unless the detail-retention advantage is confirmed.
One notable deadline story on the Payment Transactions Law amendments, but no evidence of sustained regulatory coverage.
Mass-market portal tracking bankruptcy/resolution aftermath; peripheral to A3 deadlines, revisit later.
Independent portal with occasional political-economy angles on draft financial legislation; value to A3 unproven.
Strongest English-language file on ME supervisory failure and non-enforcement; continuous investigative output.
Regional investigative outlet with a Montenegro feed covering regulator transparency and crypto-rule debate in English.
Useful emerging-markets banking wire on ME supervisory conflicts, but most article depth sits behind a subscription.
